q: The Foreman–Rudolph–Weiss theorem (2011) says the isomorphism relation on ergodic MPTs is:
opts: Classifiable by real numbers (there is a Borel complete invariant)
Not classifiable by countable structures — more complex than any orbit equivalence relation of a Polish group action
exp: FRW: the conjugacy problem for ergodic MPTs is not Borel-reducible to any orbit equivalence relation of Polish group actions. There is no Borel complete invariant. This makes ergodic theory inherently 'wild' — beyond classification theory.
